gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Bushcraft spaces its letters far apart and draws every curve at a single stroke width, so capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Anek Gurmukhi is the open-handed one here, with big round counters that keep the sans-serif text easy to follow.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-anek-latin: Expressive letters stretch out wide on top, with every stroke drawn at one thickness and no thin parts anywhere. Anek Latin is the counterweight, its lowercase rising nearly to cap height.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-anek-telugu: Wide, artistic and a bit quirky, Bushcraft closes its shapes up tight while Anek Telugu leaves its big bowls unlatched. Text in the second font moves along with a loose, friendly rhythm.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-anuphan: Bushcraft stretches its spacing wide and keeps capitals close to lowercase height. Anuphan sits beneath with big round bowls and curves that leave visible gaps, so the closed shapes above feel sealed by comparison, like a shut door beside an open window.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-athiti: Bushcraft draws every curve without any change in stroke weight, spacing its letters out extra wide. Athiti follows with a see-through s and a high mean line, looking like vinyl cut for a sign shop, and the two sit comfortably apart.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-cossette-texte: Bushcraft is the wide-spaced, expressive voice, with capitals that barely stand above its lowercase. Cossette Texte would feel cramped if the heading were shrunk down, because its prominent x-height and wide-eyed e shapes make a much louder presence than the heading's closed forms.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-gafata: Gafata stacks a generous band of lowercase under short ascenders, and its wide-eyed e gives it a contemporary air. Bushcraft is the showier one, running a single stroke width through its whole alphabet.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-gidole: Expressive and wide-spaced, Bushcraft draws each curve with no swell in weight and lets capitals blend into the lowercase. It belongs at big, short sizes, where Gidole's neon-tube strokes and open terminals stay out of its way.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Approachable in spirit, Hedvig Letters Sans leaves a wide gap where its c ends. Bushcraft, with no hairline-to-stem shift at all, keeps a longer page lively, while the body text stays easy on the eye as lowercase climbs almost to capital height.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-heebo: Expressive and wide-set, Bushcraft closes its letters up and leaves capitals nearly lost among the lowercase. Heebo comes in plainly after it, with a generous middle band and curves that stop short of closing, so the two feel like a sealed envelope next to an open hand.
